scope: General live-camera send-buffer admission and owned TCP forwarding; no GPU inference benchmarks

changes.live_camera: Check native WebSocket unsent bytes after display/network credit and before capture; poll only while nonempty, cancel on stop/end/failure
changes.control: FramePipeline bufferedBytes=null retains original ungated admission
changes.tcp: TCP_NODELAY=1 on owned relay local peer and pinned SSH TCP connection; explicit setup failure and cleanup

Model weights, model precision, detector classes, depth settings, tracking and risk rules

environment.socket_tests: Native loopback TCP and socket pairs with synthetic SSH control; no external authentication or inference
environment.frontend_tests: Node test runner; controlled timing, explicit socket/DOM adapters

verified_behaviors: Nonempty browser queue prevents new camera capture until it clears
Clear queue adds no polling timer; original ungated control remains available
Stop and normal finish release the native timer; transport failure preserves its original rejection
Persistent admission stall fails visibly; invalid counters are rejected rather than bypassed
Fresh capture timestamps occur after the explicit wait; credit wait and upload wait remain separate
All submitted frames retain order and completion accounting
CameraApp enables the real admission adapter; missing timing fields do not become NaN or artificial zero samples
Native relay and SSH TCP sockets report TCP_NODELAY=1
Pinned identity is checked before SSH socket configuration; failed configuration closes owned resources without retry
Binary partial writes and full-duplex half-close regression tests pass

controlled_fixture_comparison.interpretation: Admission moves acquisition after the controlled queue wait; completion interval still includes waiting. No model or WAN speedup is inferred.
